question: Who is the author of the book ’The Gopi Diaries: Finding Love’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudha Murty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sudha Murty** is the author of the book *"The Gopi Diaries: Finding Love."* She is a well-known Indian author, philanthropist, and chairperson of the Infosys Foundation.
 
• The book *"The Gopi Diaries: Finding Love"* is part of a series written from the perspective of a dog named Gopi, blending emotional storytelling with a sense of warmth and familial bonding.
 
• Sudha Murty is an acclaimed writer in both English and Kannada, known for her simple yet impactful writing style, making her works relatable and accessible to a wide audience.
 
• The book reflects Sudha Murty's love for animals, her ability to weave compassion into her stories, and her focus on themes like love, family, and kindness, which resonate with readers of all ages.
 
• Sudha Murty has authored numerous other popular books, including *"Wise and Otherwise,"* *"The Day I Stopped Drinking Milk,"* and *"How I Taught My Grandmother to Read."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Sudha Murty:**

 
 
• Born on **19 August 1950**, Sudha Murty is an Indian author and social worker. She is also the wife of Narayana Murthy, co-founder of Infosys.
 
• She has received several accolades, including the **Padma Shri** in 2006 for her contributions to social work.
 
• She is celebrated for her philanthropic efforts through the **Infosys Foundation**, focusing on education, healthcare, and rural development.
 
 
 
• **About The Gopi Diaries:**
 
 
• *"The Gopi Diaries"* is a trilogy centered around a dog named Gopi, narrated from his perspective. It captures the life of Gopi as he adjusts to a new family and finds love and belonging.
 
• The series is written in a language suitable for children and adults, making it a delightful read for animal lovers and families alike.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Rekha Verma:** Not associated with this book. She is not a widely recognized author in this genre or context.
 
• **Anuradha Roy:** A celebrated Indian author known for her works like *"Sleeping on Jupiter"*, but not related to *"The Gopi Diaries."*
 
• **Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni:** A well-known writer famous for books like *"The Palace of Illusions"* and *"The Forest of Enchantments,"* which focus on Indian mythology and women's perspectives. However, she is not connected to this book.
 
 
 
• **Sudha Murty's Writing Style:**
 
 
• Her writing is characterized by **simplicity**, making her stories accessible to readers across age groups.
 
• She often focuses on themes of **human values, family relationships**, and societal issues, blending them seamlessly into her narratives.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sudha Murty's Contribution to Literature:** She has written numerous books for children and adults, often emphasizing **Indian culture**, **traditions**, and **social values**.
 
• **Philanthropy:** Through the Infosys Foundation, she has contributed significantly to **education**, **healthcare**, and **rural development**, making her a role model in both literature and social work.
 
• **Recognition:** Apart from the **Padma Shri**, she has received many awards, including the **R.K. Narayan Award for Literature** and the **Attimabbe Award**.
 
• **Inspirational Figure:** Sudha Murty's life and work inspire people to value **kindness**, **empathy**, and **simplicity**, which are reflected in her stories.
